info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Activity Log API
info.description: Exposes Activity Log API endpoints for listing activity entries, counting matches, and resolving the permitted date range for the current caller.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
The zero-based offset to start returning entries from.
The maximum number of entries to return. Use `-1` to return all matching entries.
The user login to filter by, or `null` to use the current user unless the caller is a super user.
The activity type identifier to filter by.
The reporting period to filter by.
The date or date range to process. `YYYY-MM-DD`, magic keywords (`today`, `yesterday`, `lastWeek`, `lastMonth`, `lastYear`), or date range (`YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD`, `lastX`, `previousX`).

request.description: Returns Activity Log entries visible to the current caller.

response.name:
The matching activity entries with formatted metadata, descriptions, timestamps, and avatar details.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
